title.en: Making of the Constitution, the Preamble and key features

text.en:
Meena read the opening words of the Constitution on her classroom wall.
"We, the people of India," she read.

The Constituent Assembly, led by Dr Rajendra Prasad as president and Dr B. R. Ambedkar as chairman of the Drafting Committee, drafted the Constitution. It was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950.
The Preamble declares India a sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic republic and promises justice, liberty, equality and fraternity. Key features include fundamental rights, a federal structure and an independent judiciary.
The Constitution is a living document that can be amended as society changes.

problem.en: When did the Constitution come into force?

prompt.en: A friend says Dr B. R. Ambedkar was the first Prime Minister. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: Nehru was the first Prime Minister.

points.en: The Constitution came into force in 1950.
